jobs.title: Director, Technology Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Role

The Technology team is responsible for the delivery, operation, and governance of secure, compliant, and scalable platforms that support critical healthcare services and enable the successful separation and long-term independence of the Ascendiun family of companies. The Director, Technology Transformation will report to the Chief Information Officer (CIO). In this role you will for lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale programs that create sustainable, systematic improvements across technology and business operations.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In This Role, You Will

Lead strategic technology initiatives that improve operational performance, scalability, reliability, and customer experience.
Identify systemic challenges and drive sustainable solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
Partner with business and technology leaders to drive organizational change and process improvements.
Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery teams.
Establish governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure program success.
Drive prioritization, issue resolution, risk management, and decision-making across initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business outcomes.
Lead efforts to improve system stability, service performance, operational maturity, and supportability.
Facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for recurring issues.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product owners, and technology teams.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of technology experience, including 6+ years in leadership roles managing enterprise technology initiatives.
Proven experience leading large-scale technology programs and transformational initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and balancing competing priorities.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Stellarus’ vision is to empower its customers to create a healthcare experience that is worthy of their family, friends, and neighbors. Stellarus’ objective is to offer innovative, modern, scalable solutions that challenge the health care status quo. This very closely aligns with Blue Shield of California’s vision by using innovation to improve quality, affordability, and experience for members.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Our Values

At Stellarus, our core values of agility, trust, drive, courage and service shape our approach to developing innovative product offerings.

Our Workplace Model

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

Physical Requirements

Office Environment - roles involving part to full time schedule in Office Environment. Based in our physical offices and work from home office/deskwork - Activity level: Sedentary, frequency most of work day.

Please click here for further physical requirement detail.

Equal Employment Opportunity

External hires must pass a background check/drug screen. Qualified applicants with arrest records and/or conviction records will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with Federal, State and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability status and any other classification protected by Federal, State and local laws.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Venture Capital is dedicated to exploring the future of investing through fresh, innovative insights that challenge conventional thinking. The organization focuses on unique, actionable strategies and game-changing market perspectives that push the boundaries of what is possible in venture capital. Content is designed to inspire creative, out-of-the-box approaches while questioning the status quo. Information shared is for educational purposes only, with a strong emphasis on independent research and informed decision-making due to the inherent risks of venture capital investing.
Role Description
The Chief Information Officer (CIO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the overall information technology vision and strategy for Venture Capital. This role oversees IT operations, infrastructure, and security to ensure reliable, compliant, and scalable systems that support digital content and data-driven decision-making. The CIO collaborates with executive leadership to align IT strategy with business goals, optimize business processes, and identify technology opportunities that enhance innovation and user experience. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing IT teams and vendors, setting and monitoring technology KPIs, overseeing system design and implementation, and establishing policies for data governance, cybersecurity, and business continuity. The CIO is also expected to stay current with emerging technologies relevant to venture capital and recommend solutions that improve efficiency, analytics, and collaboration.
Qualifications

Strong background in Information Technology, including architecture, infrastructure, and security, with the ability to oversee complex digital environments.
Proven experience in IT Operations, such as system administration, network management, service delivery, and incident/change management.
Demonstrated IT Management capabilities, including team leadership, vendor management, budget oversight, and performance measurement.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Business Process design to align technology initiatives with organizational objectives and improve operational efficiency.
Experience implementing cloud-based solutions, data analytics platforms, and collaboration tools in a digital or financial-services context.
Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, regulatory considerations, and data privacy standards relevant to investment or financial information.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business recommendations.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., CIO, ITIL, CISSP, PMP) are beneficial.
Experience working in or with investment, financial services, or technology-driven content organizations is an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Cybersecurity, AI SOC & Crisis Management - Remote
jobs.description:
Preference will be given to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a Senior Manager, AI Security Operations & Crisis Management, you will lead the enterprise Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) and coordinate incidents through recovery and closure. You will advance AI-enabled operations and crisis readiness with Investigations, Threat Hunting & Forensics and enterprise partners.

What you will do:

Technical Responsibilities:

Lead global CIRT operations, including follow-the-sun coverage, escalation, containment, recovery, closure, and continuity during outages.
Oversee managed detection and response providers, including readiness, governance, performance, escalation quality, budgets, licensing, and commitments.
Advance responsible AI-assisted triage, investigation, decision support, documentation, and response with oversight, approvals, auditability, and reversibility.
Own the Cyber Defense digital twin roadmap and operationalize capabilities by defining use cases, requirements, success measures, acceptance, adoption, and legacy retirement.
Direct incident response; govern non-destructive containment and automated actions; and engage Investigations, Threat Hunting & Forensics when required.
Monitor response time, escalation and case quality, automation effectiveness, queue health, service levels, and corrective actions.
Own the detection content lifecycle with Detection Engineering, including rule development, tuning, coverage mapping, and deprecation.
Partner with Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, and Enterprise Technology to improve response.

Leadership & People Management Responsibilities:

Own cyber crisis management and CIRT activation, including severity criteria, escalation thresholds, leadership notifications, governance, and operational coordination.
Lead executive briefings, stakeholder updates, reporting, communication cadence, and documentation of significant decisions.
Coordinate response with crisis, communications, legal, privacy, human resources, procurement, continuity, and technology operations teams.
Lead executive tabletop, functional, and technical exercises; maintain the roadmap and close corrective actions.
Lead post-incident reviews and incorporate technical findings and root-cause lessons into playbooks and readiness activities.
Build CIRT leadership depth through coaching, exercises, structured development, and clear performance expectations.

Knowledge and Capabilities:

Apply incident response, recovery, crisis communications, business continuity, and crisis coordination practices during high-pressure events.
Translate issues into business terms and coordinate concurrent workstreams using risk-based decisions.
Integrate FDA, HIPAA, SEC cyber disclosure, sanctions compliance, and other reporting considerations into response processes.
Address threats involving contractors and contingent workers through identity verification and access revocation coordination.
Participate in after-hours or on-call incident response and crisis management activities as required.

What You Need:

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, incident response, crisis management, technology operations, or enterprise service delivery.
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams, global operations, strategic initiatives, or managed services.
Experience leading significant cybersecurity incidents with technical, business, legal, communications, and executive stakeholders.
Experience managing a Security Operations Center, CIRT, Managed Detection and Response service, or comparable operational capability.
Experience implementing or governing AI-enabled workflows, automation, orchestration, or technology-enabled operational transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Business Administration, Technology Management, or a related discipline.
Professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent.

jobs.title: VP - Prime Technology Asset Owner (TAO)
jobs.description:
Work Location
:

New York, New York, United States of America

Hours

40

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Detail

$150,000.00 - $200,000.00 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

This is a technology role responsible for supporting the design, development, implementation, maintenance, and operational health of technology systems, applications, and services. The role contributes to delivery execution, production stability, risk management, and continuous improvement while building technical depth and business knowledge. Where assigned as a Technology Asset Owner (TAO) or supporting a TAO function, this role will also help ensure technology assets are accurately registered, maintained, governed, and managed through their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Support application and technology service delivery across the full lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and retirement.
Develop, configure, test, and maintain software components, scripts, integrations, reports, or platform changes under the guidance of senior engineers.
Assist with production support, incident triage, root-cause analysis, problem resolution, and implementation of preventive actions.
Follow enterprise engineering standards, secure development practices, change management processes, and technology risk controls.
Collaborate with product owners, business partners, operations teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technology stakeholders to deliver reliable outcomes.
Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, support procedures, design notes, and evidence required for audit or compliance activities.
Monitor system health, performance, availability, vulnerabilities, software currency, and operational risks; escalate issues and support remediation planning as needed.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, delivery planning, estimation, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.
Contribute to automation, process improvement, service reliability, and reduction of manual operational effort.
Build knowledge of the business domain, technology environment, applications, dependencies, and enterprise governance expectations.

Technology Asset Owner (TAO) Responsibilities

Ensure assigned business applications, technical service offerings, or technology assets are accurately registered in TD Asset Registry (TDAR) or the applicable system of record.
Maintain accurate asset information, including lifecycle stage, ownership, contacts, dependencies, hosting details, interfaces, service relationships, and other required technical attributes.
Review, approve, or reject new asset registrations and TAO transfer requests where assigned as the accountable owner.
Keep asset lifecycle stages current, including draft, development, production, retired, and decommissioned states, within required timelines.
Complete or support data accuracy attestations, runs-on relationship reviews, currency reviews, and other recurring governance activities.
Identify, communicate, and remediate asset data quality issues, ownership gaps, control deficiencies, vulnerabilities, and compliance risks.
Work with TAO Delegates, portfolio representatives, business owners, application teams, and enterprise governance groups to ensure asset records remain complete, accurate, and auditable.
Support enterprise programs that rely on asset information, including configuration management, software currency, cybersecurity, resilience, data management, and access management processes.
Ensure required TAO and TAO Delegate training is completed and that delegates have appropriate access to perform assigned responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

Post-secondary education in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Foundational knowledge of software development, application support, systems analysis, cloud or infrastructure concepts, databases, APIs, or DevOps practices.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, analyze information, document findings, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Understanding of secure engineering, technology risk, access management, change management, and operational control practices.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented delivery environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to Agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring tools, ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, or enterprise asset management processes.
Experience supporting applications in a regulated financial services or enterprise technology environment.
Familiarity with TDAR, CMDB, application lifecycle management, software currency, access management, or audit evidence preparation.

Success Measures

Technology changes and operational activities are delivered with quality, stability, and adherence to enterprise standards.
Incidents, defects, vulnerabilities, and control gaps are supported through timely analysis, escalation, and remediation.
Technical documentation and operational procedures are accurate, accessible, and kept current.
Assigned asset records are complete, accurate, timely, and aligned to lifecycle, ownership, and governance requirements.
The engineer demonstrates continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and increasing independence in delivery and support responsibilities.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking to hire a Senior Manager, Technology Enablement.

The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement, serves as the business owner for the Practice Group's technology portfolio, ensuring the technology investments are effectively operationalized, adopted, optimized, and translated into measurable business value.

This role functions as an internal strategic consultant responsible for identifying operational opportunities, improving service delivery, leading enterprise initiatives, and maximizing the return on the Practice Group's technology investments.

Unlike traditional technology leadership positions focused on engineering or platform development, this role focuses on business enablement ensuring technology capabilities are fully leveraged through process optimization, stakeholder alignment, client engagement, operational consulting, and continuous improvement.

The Senior Manager partners directly with attorneys, clients, executive leadership, and operational teams to evaluate business needs, identify organizational blind spots, improve technology adoption, develop scalable service offerings, and lead strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.

Success in this position requires exceptional consulting, communication, operational strategy, project leadership, and change management skills, combined with deep experience within legal technology, eDiscovery, and professional services environments.

Maintaining an in-office presence is important to delivering our services through an integrated and collaborative work culture. This position will reside in any of our Boston, Washington DC, Philadelphia, Chicago, or San Francisco offices with a hybrid in-office/remote working schedule.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Consulting

Serve as the operational business owner for current Practice Group technology investments.
Partner with attorneys, clients, and operational leaders to identify opportunities to enhance utilization of existing technology and services within the Operations business unit.
Evaluate operational effectiveness and recommend process and technology improvements.
Facilitate strategic planning sessions and provide recommendations to executive leadership.
Develop operational roadmaps aligned with business and technology objectives.

Technology Enablement

Drive adoption and maximize the business value of technology solutions, including RelOne and its expansive suite of tools in addition to other applications currently supported by the Operations team.
Evaluate technology utilization, identify underused capabilities, and develop strategies to increase adoption.
Identify opportunities to eliminate redundant technology and streamline the technology environment.

Strategic Initiative Leadership

Lead enterprise and Practice Group strategic initiatives from planning through implementation.
Develop business cases, ROI analyses, and executive presentations.
Facilitate steering committees and support organizational change management.
Coordinate with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.
Provide PMO leadership and ensure initiatives remain aligned with business objectives.

Operational Excellence

Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
Apply Lean principles, process mapping, and service delivery optimization to improve business processes.
Develop KPIs, governance frameworks, SOPs, and other tools to support consistent and effective operations.
Identify opportunities to streamline operations and recommend measures to improve efficiency and reduce expenses.

Client & Attorney Engagement

Partner with attorneys, clients, and internal stakeholders to understand business needs and provide technology consulting for core eDiscovery platforms.
Participate in client pitches and presentations as needed.
Conduct technology demonstrations and provide internal attorney education as needed.
Support service enablement and promote effective use of technology solutions.

Market & Technology Evaluation

Research emerging technologies, market trends, and industry best practices for core eDiscovery platforms to supplement existing tool suites currently supported by the Operations team.
Evaluate vendors and technology solutions through demonstrations and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Conduct ROI analysis, benchmarking, and technology assessments.
Develop recommendations to support technology investment and business decisions.

Leadership & Collaboration

Lead through influence and collaboration rather than direct authority.
Build consensus and foster strong relationships across business, technology, and operational teams.
Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders at all levels.
Support strategic planning, resource optimization, and organizational priorities.
Provide recommendations related to resources, budgets, and technology investments.
Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

Measures of Success

Success In This Role Will Be Demonstrated Through

Increased technology adoption and utilization.
Reduced redundant or underutilized applications.
Successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
Improved operational KPIs and service delivery.
Increased attorney and client engagement and satisfaction.
Improved return on technology investments.
Increased operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university and minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in a large law firm, legal service provider, and/or in-house corporate environment. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Strong legal technology knowledge, including Relativity and AI solutions.
Excellent communication, consulting, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
Strong leadership, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority.
Strategic thinking and business acumen, including budgeting, financial analysis, business case development, and portfolio management.
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to change, and work collaboratively.
Ability to analyze complex information and effectively communicate recommendations to senior leadership and clients.
PMP, Relativity Expert, or Lean Six Sigma certification is preferred but not required.

Qualified candidates must apply online by visiting our website at www.morganlewis.com and selecting “Careers.”

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Your Role

The Technology team is responsible for the delivery, operation, and governance of secure, compliant, and scalable platforms that support critical healthcare services and enable the successful separation and long-term independence of the Ascendiun family of companies. The Director, Technology Transformation will report to the Chief Information Officer (CIO). In this role you will for lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale programs that create sustainable, systematic improvements across technology and business operations.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In This Role, You Will

Lead strategic technology initiatives that improve operational performance, scalability, reliability, and customer experience.
Identify systemic challenges and drive sustainable solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
Partner with business and technology leaders to drive organizational change and process improvements.
Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery teams.
Establish governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure program success.
Drive prioritization, issue resolution, risk management, and decision-making across initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business outcomes.
Lead efforts to improve system stability, service performance, operational maturity, and supportability.
Facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for recurring issues.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product owners, and technology teams.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of technology experience, including 6+ years in leadership roles managing enterprise technology initiatives.
Proven experience leading large-scale technology programs and transformational initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and balancing competing priorities.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Stellarus’ vision is to empower its customers to create a healthcare experience that is worthy of their family, friends, and neighbors. Stellarus’ objective is to offer innovative, modern, scalable solutions that challenge the health care status quo. This very closely aligns with Blue Shield of California’s vision by using innovation to improve quality, affordability, and experience for members.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Our Values

At Stellarus, our core values of agility, trust, drive, courage and service shape our approach to developing innovative product offerings.

Our Workplace Model

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

Physical Requirements

Office Environment - roles involving part to full time schedule in Office Environment. Based in our physical offices and work from home office/deskwork - Activity level: Sedentary, frequency most of work day.

Please click here for further physical requirement detail.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability status and any other classification protected by Federal, State and local laws.

new_jobs.description:
Work Location
:

New York, New York, United States of America

Hours

40

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Detail

$150,000.00 - $200,000.00 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

This is a technology role responsible for supporting the design, development, implementation, maintenance, and operational health of technology systems, applications, and services. The role contributes to delivery execution, production stability, risk management, and continuous improvement while building technical depth and business knowledge. Where assigned as a Technology Asset Owner (TAO) or supporting a TAO function, this role will also help ensure technology assets are accurately registered, maintained, governed, and managed through their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Support application and technology service delivery across the full lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and retirement.
Develop, configure, test, and maintain software components, scripts, integrations, reports, or platform changes under the guidance of senior engineers.
Assist with production support, incident triage, root-cause analysis, problem resolution, and implementation of preventive actions.
Follow enterprise engineering standards, secure development practices, change management processes, and technology risk controls.
Collaborate with product owners, business partners, operations teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technology stakeholders to deliver reliable outcomes.
Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, support procedures, design notes, and evidence required for audit or compliance activities.
Monitor system health, performance, availability, vulnerabilities, software currency, and operational risks; escalate issues and support remediation planning as needed.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, delivery planning, estimation, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities.
Contribute to automation, process improvement, service reliability, and reduction of manual operational effort.
Build knowledge of the business domain, technology environment, applications, dependencies, and enterprise governance expectations.

Technology Asset Owner (TAO) Responsibilities

Ensure assigned business applications, technical service offerings, or technology assets are accurately registered in TD Asset Registry (TDAR) or the applicable system of record.
Maintain accurate asset information, including lifecycle stage, ownership, contacts, dependencies, hosting details, interfaces, service relationships, and other required technical attributes.
Review, approve, or reject new asset registrations and TAO transfer requests where assigned as the accountable owner.
Keep asset lifecycle stages current, including draft, development, production, retired, and decommissioned states, within required timelines.
Complete or support data accuracy attestations, runs-on relationship reviews, currency reviews, and other recurring governance activities.
Identify, communicate, and remediate asset data quality issues, ownership gaps, control deficiencies, vulnerabilities, and compliance risks.
Work with TAO Delegates, portfolio representatives, business owners, application teams, and enterprise governance groups to ensure asset records remain complete, accurate, and auditable.
Support enterprise programs that rely on asset information, including configuration management, software currency, cybersecurity, resilience, data management, and access management processes.
Ensure required TAO and TAO Delegate training is completed and that delegates have appropriate access to perform assigned responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

Post-secondary education in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Foundational knowledge of software development, application support, systems analysis, cloud or infrastructure concepts, databases, APIs, or DevOps practices.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, analyze information, document findings, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Understanding of secure engineering, technology risk, access management, change management, and operational control practices.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to work effectively in a team-oriented delivery environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to Agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring tools, ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, or enterprise asset management processes.
Experience supporting applications in a regulated financial services or enterprise technology environment.
Familiarity with TDAR, CMDB, application lifecycle management, software currency, access management, or audit evidence preparation.

Success Measures

Technology changes and operational activities are delivered with quality, stability, and adherence to enterprise standards.
Incidents, defects, vulnerabilities, and control gaps are supported through timely analysis, escalation, and remediation.
Technical documentation and operational procedures are accurate, accessible, and kept current.
Assigned asset records are complete, accurate, timely, and aligned to lifecycle, ownership, and governance requirements.
The engineer demonstrates continuous learning, collaboration, accountability, and increasing independence in delivery and support responsibilities.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com. Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

new_jobs.description:
Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking to hire a Senior Manager, Technology Enablement.

The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement, serves as the business owner for the Practice Group's technology portfolio, ensuring the technology investments are effectively operationalized, adopted, optimized, and translated into measurable business value.

This role functions as an internal strategic consultant responsible for identifying operational opportunities, improving service delivery, leading enterprise initiatives, and maximizing the return on the Practice Group's technology investments.

Unlike traditional technology leadership positions focused on engineering or platform development, this role focuses on business enablement ensuring technology capabilities are fully leveraged through process optimization, stakeholder alignment, client engagement, operational consulting, and continuous improvement.

The Senior Manager partners directly with attorneys, clients, executive leadership, and operational teams to evaluate business needs, identify organizational blind spots, improve technology adoption, develop scalable service offerings, and lead strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.

Success in this position requires exceptional consulting, communication, operational strategy, project leadership, and change management skills, combined with deep experience within legal technology, eDiscovery, and professional services environments.

Maintaining an in-office presence is important to delivering our services through an integrated and collaborative work culture. This position will reside in any of our Boston, Washington DC, Philadelphia, Chicago, or San Francisco offices with a hybrid in-office/remote working schedule.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Consulting

Serve as the operational business owner for current Practice Group technology investments.
Partner with attorneys, clients, and operational leaders to identify opportunities to enhance utilization of existing technology and services within the Operations business unit.
Evaluate operational effectiveness and recommend process and technology improvements.
Facilitate strategic planning sessions and provide recommendations to executive leadership.
Develop operational roadmaps aligned with business and technology objectives.

Technology Enablement

Drive adoption and maximize the business value of technology solutions, including RelOne and its expansive suite of tools in addition to other applications currently supported by the Operations team.
Evaluate technology utilization, identify underused capabilities, and develop strategies to increase adoption.
Identify opportunities to eliminate redundant technology and streamline the technology environment.

Strategic Initiative Leadership

Lead enterprise and Practice Group strategic initiatives from planning through implementation.
Develop business cases, ROI analyses, and executive presentations.
Facilitate steering committees and support organizational change management.
Coordinate with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.
Provide PMO leadership and ensure initiatives remain aligned with business objectives.

Operational Excellence

Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
Apply Lean principles, process mapping, and service delivery optimization to improve business processes.
Develop KPIs, governance frameworks, SOPs, and other tools to support consistent and effective operations.
Identify opportunities to streamline operations and recommend measures to improve efficiency and reduce expenses.

Client & Attorney Engagement

Partner with attorneys, clients, and internal stakeholders to understand business needs and provide technology consulting for core eDiscovery platforms.
Participate in client pitches and presentations as needed.
Conduct technology demonstrations and provide internal attorney education as needed.
Support service enablement and promote effective use of technology solutions.

Market & Technology Evaluation

Research emerging technologies, market trends, and industry best practices for core eDiscovery platforms to supplement existing tool suites currently supported by the Operations team.
Evaluate vendors and technology solutions through demonstrations and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Conduct ROI analysis, benchmarking, and technology assessments.
Develop recommendations to support technology investment and business decisions.

Leadership & Collaboration

Lead through influence and collaboration rather than direct authority.
Build consensus and foster strong relationships across business, technology, and operational teams.
Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders at all levels.
Support strategic planning, resource optimization, and organizational priorities.
Provide recommendations related to resources, budgets, and technology investments.
Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

Measures of Success

Success In This Role Will Be Demonstrated Through

Increased technology adoption and utilization.
Reduced redundant or underutilized applications.
Successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
Improved operational KPIs and service delivery.
Increased attorney and client engagement and satisfaction.
Improved return on technology investments.
Increased operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university and minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in a large law firm, legal service provider, and/or in-house corporate environment. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Strong legal technology knowledge, including Relativity and AI solutions.
Excellent communication, consulting, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
Strong leadership, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority.
Strategic thinking and business acumen, including budgeting, financial analysis, business case development, and portfolio management.
Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to change, and work collaboratively.
Ability to analyze complex information and effectively communicate recommendations to senior leadership and clients.
PMP, Relativity Expert, or Lean Six Sigma certification is preferred but not required.

Qualified candidates must apply online by visiting our website at www.morganlewis.com and selecting “Careers.”
